{{Quote|The enemy raid on Wayland justifies the precautions we took in moving the defectors there. The air strike inflicted significant damage to New Nystao, but fatalities were minimal - which wouldn't have been the case had we relocated them to Bilbringi or some other more populous world.|Belindi Kalenda|<ref name="AoCI:HT" />}}
The '''raid on Wayland''' was a [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] operation by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in order to secure the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Elan]]'s cover as a defector during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. An [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong assassin (Wayland)|assassin]] trained under [[Domain Shai]] was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] to attempt the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of Elan. New Republic forces thwarted the assassination attempt, however, [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence]] analyst [[Yintal]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the fight and the operation solidified the perception that Elan was a legitimate defector with valuable intelligence.<ref name="AoCI:HT" />
